prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all individual change types as each has only been tested once.
Adoption new_flow is the only change type proven helpful so far, securing a significant win.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests compared to noise-corrected results.
Most round 2 predictions remained too high, though predictions for home new_flow and choose_path layout were too low.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +3.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +1.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Express Starter Companion Flow: Rebuilds the adoption selection stage into a streamlined starter companion flow using interactive stage presets. (why: Adoption step drops 36.7% of users and has long duration (median 89s / mean 1017s); prior test evidence shows adoption new_flow is effective.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Protection Hint: Adds an explanatory hint beneath sign-in options clarifying how sign-in protects pet data across app relaunches. (why: Top support concern (8 emails) is pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in step conversion is 72.9%.)
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive Calibration Waiting Flow: Transforms the waiting step into a companion trait calibration flow with interactive progress indicators. (why: Waiting screen has high drop-off and long mean time (2336s); round 2 evidence showed home new_flow outperformed predictions.)
3: [finish, redesign] Split Layout Interaction Showcase: Redesigns the home_intro finish screen into a split view showing key desktop control hotkeys and pet interaction tips. (why: 3 support tickets cited confusion over how to control, hide, or speak to the pet, and 4 noted post-onboarding misbehavior.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Persistent Profile Sign-In Copy: Updates sign_in screen headline and body text to highlight account syncing as pet backup security. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% and 8 support messages report pet loss/reset upon re-authenticating.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Shortcut Quick Hint: Displays an inline helper hint on the finish screen explaining simple pet visibility controls. (why: 3 support emails explicitly asked how to control or hide pets on the desktop after completing onboarding.)
6: [home, wait_info] Pet Spawn Wait Estimate Info: Adds progress bar, time estimate, and notification option on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user frustration and churn.)
